label: The critical voltage
subgoals: Divide the thermal voltage by root two times the saturation current
Take the natural log of that ratio

label: Limiting a forward step
subgoals: Check that the proposal exceeds the critical voltage
Check that the step exceeds twice the thermal voltage
Replace the proposal by the logarithmic step from the old voltage

label: When limiting does nothing
subgoals: Keep proposals below the critical voltage unchanged
Keep steps of at most twice the thermal voltage unchanged
Use the thermal-voltage log of the proposal when the old voltage was not positive
